title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 877 East 1200 South in Orem, Utah, as the Jerry C. Washburn Post Office Building.
official_summary: Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 877 East 1200 South in Orem, Utah, as the "Jerry C. Washburn Post Office Building."

summary.headline: A law that renames a Postal Service building in Orem, Utah, after Jerry C. Washburn.
summary.what_it_does: This law names the U.S. Postal Service building at 877 East 1200 South in Orem, Utah, the Jerry C. Washburn Post Office Building. It changes only the official name of the facility. It does not change how the post office operates or what services it offers.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was signed on December 12, 2019.
